First, note the given date: 05-02-1137 (likely DD-MM-YYYY format → 5th February 1137).  

25 weeks + 7 days = 25 × 7 + 7 = 175 + 7 = 182 days.  

Subtract 182 days from 1137-02-05:  

1137 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but year < 1582, but using Gregorian rules anyway).  
February has 28 days in 1137.  

From Feb 5:  
Back 5 days → Jan 31, 1137.  
Remaining days: 182 − 5 = 177 days.  

From Jan 31, 1137:  
Back 31 days → Dec 31, 1136.  
Remaining: 177 − 31 = 146 days.  

From Dec 31, 1136:  
December has 31 days, so back another 31 → Nov 30, 1136. Remaining: 146 − 31 = 115 days.  
November has 30 days → back 30 → Oct 31, 1136. Remaining: 115 − 30 = 85 days.  
October has 31 days → back 31 → Sep 30, 1136. Remaining: 85 − 31 = 54 days.  
September has 30 days → back 30 → Aug 31, 1136. Remaining: 54 − 30 = 24 days.  
From Aug 31, back 24 days → Aug 7, 1136.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1136-08-07
